craft_notes: Sthāyin: once-is-enough joy (sakṛt). Sanskrit first: qualification + minimal act + fruit → L4 sets ground line 1, fruit line 2. Rows: row 1 (complete-last — caritārtha closes as complete closes). Rupture: dash after served — act done, presence stated. Close: end-weight on completion. Minimal pass: 'session' for sevita (served-as-sitting sung). Read aloud: cast, served, face-to-face. Rejected: 'worshipped' for sevita — killed: served kept (attendance, not worship); 'ultimate' for para — killed: Supreme kept.

lines: Senses cast, one session served — the Supreme
stands face to face with him whose task's complete.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirastakaraṇo yena samādhiḥ sevitaḥ sakṛt / paraḥ sākṣātkṛtas tena caritārthena yoginā

reads_against.argmap: Senses cast off, absorption served once — the supreme made face to face by the done-aimed yogin.
c1_essence: Senses cast off, absorption once served: supreme faced.
